claims.statement: The Zalo Bot webhook path commits the inbound message, acquires the per-conversation DB lock with an owner token, enqueues a job onto the webhook_high RQ queue, and returns a sub-second ack; the LLM-bound work runs on worker-chatbot (×2) via graph.runner.run_turn.
The web process does not run the agent; the synchronous answer path returns the Zalo ack in <1 s and the agent executes on worker-chatbot so a slow LLM call cannot block a webhook.

Background queues isolate latency-sensitive and slow work: webhook_high (chatbot ×2), persistence_low (persistence ×1), ingest (ingest ×1), followup (followup ×1 + scheduler ×1); per-worker replica counts are intentional and match each queue's volume and isolation requirement.

Lifespan tick registration uses register_unique_tick / register_unique_cron_tick so exactly one recurring job exists per tick, closing the prior ~12x duplicate-tick bug; a failure to register any tick is logged as non-fatal so it cannot block web startup.

Periodic ticks cover proactive follow-up (PROACTIVE_TICK_INTERVAL_SECONDS default 1800s), reconcile sweep (settings.reconcile_interval_seconds), outbound dispatcher, decision trace retention, and external-source / single-page external-source sync (cron settings.kb_sync_cron).

Realtime push from worker-chatbot reaches the recruiter console via a cross-process Socket.IO bridge in app/realtime/emitter.py so a turn that finishes in a worker appears on the console without polling; the legacy /realtime/* SSE path is kept as a fallback with flush_interval -1.

Reliability invariants: sub-second Zalo ack, one in-flight turn per conversation via DB lock + owner token + bot_lock_ttl_seconds (180 s), pre_send_guard refuses to send on a lapsed lock, reconcile sweep every 60s recovers lost turns in ~3-4 minutes, and graceful shutdown drains direct turns (5 s) before disposing the DB engine and closing LLM clients.
LLM call concurrency is capped by a Redis-backed semaphore and shed with the static Vietnamese DEGRADATION_REPLY when throttled, matching the 2 vCPU / 4 GB droplet's parallel-inference ceiling.
